goal: Static analysis gate: what the static security scan must find clean before a merge.
use: Static analysis gate: what the static security scan must find clean before a merge. Use when a pipeline runs static analysis on code.

steps.note: Confirm the scan runs on every pull request, not only nightly.
Set the blocking rule. New high and critical findings block the merge.
Set the baseline. Existing findings are recorded, not hidden.
Check the bypass path. Flag suppressed findings with no owner or reason.
Report. The rule, the threshold, the owner and any gap.
